title: Altria Group Distribution Company Recalls Flashlight Due to Burn, Injury Hazards; Distributed Exclusively through Marlboro Promotion (Recall Alert)
summary: Matches inside the match holder can ignite when in contact with the striker pad beneath the compass cap, posing burn and injury hazards to consumers. Units: About 365,000.

title: J. Crew Recalls Baby Coveralls Due to Choking Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Snaps on the coveralls can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 8,700.

title: RMP Athletic Locker Recalls Boys' Hooded Jackets; Drawstrings Pose Strangulation Hazard
summary: The jackets have a drawstring around the neck area which poses a strangulation hazard to children. Drawstrings can become entangled or caught on playground slides, hand rails, school- bus doors or other moving objects, posing a significant strangulation and/or entanglement hazard to children. title: BMC Recalls Three Models of Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard; Bicycle Forks Can Break
summary: The bicycle forks can crack or break above the brake mount posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 160.

title: Exmark Recalls Quest ZRT Riding Mowers Due to Loss of Steering Control and Crash Hazard
summary: The riding mower's steering assembly can fail and cause riders to lose steering, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 5,300 in the United States and 40 in Canada (About 2,200 Quest 2009 and 2010 ZRT riding mowers were previously recalled in May 2012 for a different hazard.).

title: Gree Reannounces Dehumidifier Recall Due to Serious Fire and Burn Hazards; More Fires and Property Damage Reported
summary: The dehumidifiers can overheat, smoke and catch fire, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 2.5 million in the United States and 55,000 in Canada (This recall was first announced in September 2013, updated in October 2013 and expanded in January 2014).

title: H&M Recalls Girls’ Leggings Due to Choking Hazard
summary: A metal part on the belt can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 65,000.

title: Legrand Wiremold Expands Recall of Under-Cabinet Power Strips Due to Electric Fire Hazard
summary: The internal electrical connections of the power strips are substandard, posing risks of overheating and fire. Units: About 46,000 in the U.S. and about 169 in Canada (About 14,200 were previously recalled September 2012).

title: Nantucket Distributing Recalls Felt Easter Baskets Due to Choking Hazard
summary: Decorative beads on the felt Easter baskets can detach and pose a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 24,200.

title: StyleCraft Recalls Upholstered Benches Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at HomeGoods
summary: The benches can crack and break while in use, posing a fall hazard to consumers Units: About 700.

title: Cabela's Recalls Electronic Jerky Blaster Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The battery charger adapter can overcharge causing the Electronic Jerky Blaster's battery and battery charger adapter to overheat. Units: About 600.

title: Dimension Industries Recalls Outdoor Dining Chairs Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Costco
summary: The legs of the chairs can bend and break, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 6,700.

title: Avon Recalls Ergonomic Eyelash Curler Due to Eye Injury Hazard
summary: The eyelash curler can break, exposing a metal pin, which poses an eye injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 478,000 in the United States and 41,795 in Canada.

title: Misty Mate Recalls Hand-Held Personal Misters Due to Risk of Laceration; Sold Exclusively at Hibbet Sports
summary: The mister can shatter during use, posing a risk of laceration to the consumer. Units: About 9,000.

title: Paramount Recalls Trident Ultraviolet Sanitation Systems for Pools Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Electrical arcing can cause the units to catch fire, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 960.

title: Coleman Recalls Northstar Lanterns Due to Fire Hazard
summary: An incorrect gas feed tube was installed on the lantern. When lit, the tube can release too much fuel, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 95.

title: Classic Concepts Recalls Aman Trunks Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard; Sold Exclusively at Cost Plus World Market
summary: The surface coating paint on the interior metal chains contains excessive levels of lead, a violation of the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 1,150.

title: Discount School Supply Recalls Sorting Boards Due to Magnet Ingestion Risk and Excessive Lead Levels (Recall Alert)
summary: The magnet in the wand can detach and the plywood backing can crack and release small metal balls that are sandwiched between the board and a clear plastic cover. title: Cycling Sports Group Recalls Cannondale Tandem Road Bicycles Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The bicycle fork can break and cause the riders to lose control, posing a risk of injury. Units: About 80.

title: Sunbeam Recalls Holmes Ceramic Heaters Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The ceramic heaters can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 151,600.

title: Trident Recalls Ultraviolet Sanitation Systems for Pools Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Electrical arcing can cause the units to catch fire, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 3,660.

title: Hamilton Beach Recalls Baby Food Makers Due to Small Parts Hazard
summary: Use of the slicing/shredding disc with the motor shaft adapter can cause the stainless steel pin in the food bowl lid to loosen and fall into processed food. Units: About 790 in the U.S. and about 3,100 in Canada.

title: Lithonia Lighting Recalls Emergency Lights Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The circuit board can overheat and cause the fixture to melt, catch fire and ignite nearby items, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 1.7 million.

title: Children’s Pajamas Recalled by Empress Arts Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standards
summary: The pajamas fail to meet federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 1,400.

title: Precision Shooting Recalls Crossbows Due to Injury Hazard; Can Fire Unexpectedly
summary: The crossbow can fire an arrow without the trigger being pulled, posing an injury hazard to the user and to bystanders. Units: About 2,800.

title: Cordelia Lighting Recalls Two-Lamp Fluorescent Shop Lights Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Home Depot
summary: The lamp sockets can allow loose connections, posing a risk of an electrical arc and fire. Units: About 222,000.

title: Lakeshore Learning Materials Recalls Bristle Builders for Toddlers Play Sets Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The base of the three animal figures can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 2,000.

title: Office Depot Recalls Gibson Leather Task Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The mounting plate weld can break and separate the seat from the base of the chair, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,400,000.

title: Nest Labs Recalls to Repair Nest Protect Smoke + CO Alarms Due to Failure to Sound Alert
summary: Activity near the product during a fire can prevent the alarm from immediately sounding when the Nest Wave feature is enabled. Units: About 440,000.

title: Adult Portable Bed Handles Recalled by Bed Handles Inc. Due to Entrapment and Strangulation Hazards; Three Deaths Reported
summary: When attached to an adult's bed without the use of safety retention straps, the handle can shift out of place, creating a dangerous gap between the bed handle and the side of the mattress. This poses a serious risk of entrapment, strangulation and death. Units: About 113,000.
